name: 幽影树
habitat: 野外捕捉精灵介绍：似乎不会发生进化。 左手和右手似乎有独自的想法，在黑暗中看起来就像三只精灵。 有时候会静止不动伪装成普通树木的样子，虽然任谁都一眼就能被识破
habitatEn: Caught in the wild. Creature introduction: it does not seem to evolve. Its left and right hands seem to have minds of their own, and in the dark it looks just like three spirits. Sometimes it stands motionless and disguises itself as an ordinary tree, though anyone can see through it at a glance.
description: 左手和右手似乎有各自的想法，在黑暗中看起来就像三只精灵。虽然伪装拙劣到谁都能看穿的程度，但依旧喜欢伪装成普通树木的样子，跟在洛克身后，但是对洛克并没有恶意。
descriptionEn: Its left and right hands seem to have minds of their own, and in the dark it looks just like three spirits. Although its disguise is so clumsy that anyone can see through it, it still likes to disguise itself as an ordinary tree and follow behind Roco, though it means no harm to Roco.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%, counters attacks.

skills.name: 诡刺
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 汲取
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage and drains 100% of the damage as HP.

skills.name: 聚盐
skills.description: 2连击，每次连击自己回复8%生命，使用后本技能连击数永久+1。
skills.descriptionEn: 2 hits; each hit restores 8% HP to itself; after use, this skill's combo count permanently +1.

skills.name: 虚化
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：自己获得魔防+70%。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 80%; countering attacks: self gains M.DEF +70%.

skills.name: 坟场搏击
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方每有1能量，本次技能威力-10%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; for each energy the enemy has, this skill's power -10%.

skills.name: 降灵
skills.descriptionEn: Inflicts 1 stack of Spirit Descent Mark on the enemy.

skills.name: 花香
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 恶作剧
skills.description: 敌方失去3能量，应对防御：改为敌方失去6能量。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy loses 3 energy; countering defense: the enemy loses 6 energy instead.

skills.name: 幽灵爆发
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 盛开
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+30，应对防御：改为威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains all skills power +30; countering defense: power +60 instead.

skills.name: 彗星
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每失去5%生命，本次技能威力-10，使用后消耗全部生命。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for every 5% HP lost, this skill's power -10; after use, consumes all HP.
